bio: Nestled in 35 acres of picturesque countryside, West Lodge Park is a 4 star hotel that offers the perfect urban retreat. Why not escape the hustle and bustle of city living, and indulge in a traditional Afternoon Tea before enjoying a stroll around the beautiful grounds?  Afternoon Tea is served in the quaint Mary Beale Restaurant, the Terrace Bar or the luscious patio on a sunny day. The tranquil settings are ideal for enjoying a leisurely Afternoon Tea with friends and family.  The West Lodge Park Afternoon Tea includes all of the classic features- an array of delicate freshly cut finger sandwiches, warm scones with jam and thick clotted cream and a choice of delectable miniature cakes. If you're feeling particularly decadent, why not add a glass of Prosecco or Champagne to your Afternoon Tea?  West Lodge Park is easily accesible from Essex, Buckinghmashire and North London. The hotel has a long, rich history which is reflected in the extensive art collection adorning the walls.
